notes: This fixture freezes visually accepted edge alpha-valid black coordinates for already reviewed indirect diffuse packages.
Passing this guard means no newly introduced edge black coordinates beyond the reviewed baseline. Physical zero edge black texels is a separate stricter goal.
Counts use unique texel coordinates. Diagnostic scans that count row and column edges can count corner texels twice.
Floor and ceiling old short-circuit packages are excluded here. Add entries only after hybrid bake and visual acceptance.
Tests must fail on hash mismatch. Human review updates this fixture after the new package is accepted.
Baseline entries must be generated with createBaselineEntry from the reviewed atlas and metadata.
Human edits must not widen allowedEdgeBlackRuns. Rebuild the entry after review instead.
